title: Preserve statvfs numeric semantics under Linux strict Clippy

criteria: Linux strict scoped Clippy has no useless statvfs conversions or suppressions.
Filesystem block counts widen to u64 before saturating multiplication for u32 and u64 ABI fields.
Existing host metrics tests and new width, saturation, and zero regressions pass.
Windows implementation remains unchanged; independent review completes before native checkpoint.
